english: It's a shovel. It's also a pickaxe, an axe and a skinning knife.\n\nA reforged steel head that mines, chops, digs and butchers - and beats every dedicated steel tool at its own speciality. Takes the full set of tool mods.

Someone spent a long time working out how to make one tool do the job of four, and then locked the drawings in a hardened chest.\n\nReading this permanently unlocks the Chaotic Multi-Tool recipe. Nothing else will - no perk level teaches it. Building one still costs the parts of a full steel tool set plus a chainsaw core, and its quality is set by your Harvesting Tools skill.
